rules.Move: friendly movable actor (Worker/Light/Heavy/Ranged) and at least one legal move_dir
rules.Harvest: friendly Worker and adjacent Resource in harvest_dir
rules.Return: friendly Worker and adjacent friendly Base/stockpile in return_dir (carried-resource availability may be partial)
rules.Produce: friendly Base/Barracks, produce_dir to adjacent free cell, produce_unit_type constrained by producer (Base->Worker; Barracks->combat units if available), resource-cost check optional if unavailable
rules.Attack: friendly combat-capable unit (Worker/Light/Heavy/Ranged) with at least one enemy in local 7x7, attack_target_local only on enemy offsets

branch_rules: Branch masks are applied only when corresponding action_type is selected
Invalid branch values must not be selected
If all branch options are invalid for selected action_type, that action_type must be masked out
Never make a non-NoOp action legal for off-actor cells

runtime_authority_note: Mask is pre-selection only and never replaces runtime validation or command acceptance authority.
